entries.subject: Fix missing db parameters errors
entries.notes: sync ef2fcd20e2: upstream makes CentralColumns / MultiTableQuery / database Privileges controllers return a 400 missingParameterError('db') when the db GET/POST param is absent or an invalid name (previously: throw / stale Current::$database / generic message). We carry db as a mandatory URL path segment (/s/:server/db/:db/… and /databases/:db/…): an absent or empty segment never matches the Hono route (verified: /databases//privileges -> 404, //central-columns -> 404), so there is no crash/stale-db gap to close. withDb(select:true) additionally guards a selected-but-missing db with "No database selected." The MultiTableQuery Current::$database -> DatabaseName change is moot for us (db comes from the path via withDb, never a global).

entries.subject: New respondWithErrorMessage()
entries.notes: sync ef2fcd20e2: extracts duplicated AJAX/redirect error-response code into ResponseRenderer::respondWithErrorMessage() across ~33 controllers — output-neutral EXCEPT it consolidates the error string "No databases selected." (plural) -> "No database selected." (singular) everywhere, including the genuinely-plural DestroyController and the strNoDatabasesSelected JS key (strNoAccountSelected stays plural). Ported the singular form across our server (withDb default + export/import/insert-edit/sql/table-scope/table-structure/metadata/server-admin/shell), DatabasesPage.tsx, int tests and feature docs; phpMyAdmin .pot is not yet re-extracted so "No database selected." has no catalogue entry (both apps show untranslated English) and the orphaned plural msgid is recorded n/a in tools/parity/map/messages.yaml. parity:check 100%, re-baselined.
